note: Six ways to place subjects on a 3x3 grid. Each has 4-6 variants in the source image (first variant highlighted).

items.name: Intersection
items.description: Subject sits on one of the four points where the grid lines cross.
items.prompt: subject placed on a rule-of-thirds intersection point

items.name: Axis
items.description: An elongated subject follows a vertical or horizontal third line (an oval along an axis).
items.prompt: subject aligned along a rule-of-thirds axis

items.name: Line
items.description: A thin line (horizon, edge, pole) sits on a third line rather than the centre.
items.prompt: horizon placed on the upper or lower third line

items.name: Filled column
items.description: One or two vertical thirds are filled with the subject; the rest left open.
items.prompt: subject fills one vertical third, open space in the other two

items.name: Filled row
items.description: One or two horizontal thirds are filled with the subject or sky/ground; the rest left open.
items.prompt: subject fills one horizontal third, open space in the others

items.name: Diagonal
items.description: Subject or mass runs diagonally and splits the frame along the grid.
items.prompt: diagonal composition splitting the frame across thirds
